whatChanged: NEW: Nvidia in talks to guarantee roughly $250bn of lease and debt financing for OpenAI's 10GW, SoftBank-developed Ohio data-center campus, with a separate ~$350bn chip-financing line under discussion (nvda-openai-datacenter-backstop)
ADVANCED: EQT raises its non-binding takeover proposal for Perpetual to A$22.50/share (~A$2.65bn) after the board rejected A$22.07 (rumored → rumored) (ppt-eqt-takeover-bid)

DROPPED: 9 stale deals (no new phase in 21+ days: ezj-castlelake-takeover, itv-sky-me-sale, wulf-anthropic-lease, ho-exail-acquisition, lmt-ultra-maritime-acquisition, crto-vista-quinti-takeover-interest, carlsberg-sapporo-sea-jv, fct-underwater-champion-acquisitions, sols-esi-acquisition)

themes.label: UK-listed franchises broken up or taken private
themes.note: UK-listed names remain a magnet for control-changing bids: Apollo's agreed £5.7bn take-private of easyJet is still awaiting a firm offer by its August 7 deadline (ezj-apollo-takeover), Prologis's 'best and final' £14bn proposal for Segro has the board minded to recommend with the PUSU deadline extended to August 12 (pld-sgro-takeover-bid), and CD&R-owned OCS Group's agreed GBP3.1bn takeover of Mitie will remove another name from the LSE entirely (ocs-mitie-acquisition).

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: PE- and shareholder-led buyouts keep pulling listed names private: Apollo's £5.7bn take-private of easyJet (ezj-apollo-takeover), Steel Partners' $16.75/share bid for InMode (inmd-steel-partners-buyout), EQT/Advent/KKR circling Qiagen (qgen-pe-consortium-takeover-interest), Perfect Corp.'s founder-led going-private deal (perf-projectny-going-private), EQT's fourth and now A$22.50/share approach for Perpetual (ppt-eqt-takeover-bid), Frasers Group's shareholder-led EUR38/share tender for Hugo Boss (boss-frasers-takeover-offer), Stripe and Advent's $53bn+ offer for PayPal still live after board rejection (pypl-stripe-advent-takeover-bid), and OCS Group's CD&R-backed takeover of Mitie (ocs-mitie-acquisition).

themes.label: AI data-center capacity and power build-out
themes.note: Capital and commercial commitments keep pouring into the physical layer of AI compute: Nvidia's talks to backstop ~$250bn of financing for OpenAI's 10GW Ohio campus (nvda-openai-datacenter-backstop), Meta's Louisiana campus expanded to 5GW and $50bn+ (meta-richland-parish-capex), Williams's $5.34bn Blackstone-led JV funding five behind-the-meter data-center power projects (wmb-blackstone-power-jv), 3M and Microsoft's optical-infrastructure partnership for Azure (mmm-msft-ai-datacenter-partnership), Microsoft's at-scale deployment of AMD's Helios systems (msft-amd-helios-partnership), AMD's up-to-$5bn equity bet on Anthropic tied to a 2GW MI450 deployment (amd-anthropic-chip-partnership), NVIDIA's $1.5bn prepaid packaging capacity at Amkor (amkr-nvidia-packaging-partnership), Verizon's $1bn dark-fiber deal with Google (vz-google-fiber-partnership), Alphabet's 2026 capex guide raised to as much as $205bn (googl-capex-raise-2026), Samsung Electronics' ~$200bn memory and foundry MOU with Broadcom (samsungelec-avgo-chip-partnership), and SK hynix's long-term HBM pact with NVIDIA behind a 2GW Vera Rubin AI factory (skhynix-nvda-ai-partnership).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Deals investors thought were settled keep drawing legal fire: the signed, DOJ-cleared Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros. Discovery merger is formally paused by court stipulation until five days after an antitrust trial or June 1, 2027, with Paramount owing ~$7m/day if the pause runs past September 30, 2026 (psky-wbd-acquisition), while InMode's special committee remains procedurally frozen pending the Haifa court's ruling on the competing buyout bids (inmd-steel-partners-buyout).
